zh: 平台扩展包升级到格式 3：可以声明图标、有无包装和介质、包装与介质的 GLB 模型、区域封面比例和材质，主题仍可按槽位覆盖。
平台包可以选择让 Logo 跟随主题颜色。
en: System packs move to format 3: they can declare icons, whether packaging and media exist, box and media GLB models, regional cover ratios and materials. Themes can still override each slot.
System packs can opt into theme-colored logos.
